node.title: A=1 core-one zero-weld exclusion
node.statement: On the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree sharp cap, the sole possible K=0 profile would have b=0,D_*=1,C_*=e and F(U,V)-G_0(X)=Q_*V_0, with G_0 omitting exactly three residual-domain points. At a G_0 root, Q_* divides the squarefree clean-slope product F and is saturated. At each omitted point it has no clean-slope root and at most the one exceptional root, so the three points contribute at least 3(e-1)>e to C_*, contradicting C_*=e. Hence K is nonzero on every profile of this face; the nonzero-weld branch remains open.
